name: Naturale Kamala
shortDescription: A boutique community of 14 private pool villas on Layi-Nakha Lay Road in Kamala, by AAG Development.
description:
Naturale Kamala is a boutique community of 14 private pool villas on Layi-Nakha Lay Road in Kamala, built by AAG Development. Listings show 3 to 5 bedroom villas, each with a private pool.

It is a different project from Naturale Cherng Talay, which AAG is building in Bang Tao. Completion is quoted as Q2 2028, and a developer price list from October 2026 notes that two of the 14 villas had already sold.

Prices start from about 58.5 million baht in listings and rise sharply for the largest villas. Ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list and what remains.
